1060.description: A bench-supported bridge with a barbell across your hips. It is a go-to move for building strong glutes.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell over your hips.
Plant your feet hip-width apart and drive through your heels.
Lift your hips until your torso is level with the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and keep your chin tucked.
Lower your hips under control.
Repeat without arching your lower back.

1124.description: A single-arm push on one strap that trains the chest while the core fights rotation.
instructions: Hold one handle, lean forward and place your feet wide for balance.
Keep your hips square.
Bend your elbow and lower your chest toward the hand.
Resist twisting at the torso.
Press back to a straight arm.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

1188.description: A weighted crunch with a rotation done on a bench that trains the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie back on a bench with your knees bent and a weight held on your chest.
Brace your abs and curl your upper body up.
Rotate your torso so one elbow moves toward the opposite knee.
Lower back down slowly without letting go of tension.
Alternate sides each rep.

1316.description: Lying on a bench, move a barbell in an arc behind your head and back over your chest with soft elbows. It works the lats and chest.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your head at one end and your feet on the floor.
Hold a barbell with a shoulder-width grip and extend your arms straight above your chest.
Lower the barbell behind your head while keeping your arms slightly bent.
Pause for a moment, then raise the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，头放在一端，双脚放在地板上。
握距与肩同宽，握住杠铃，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
将杠铃放在脑后，同时保持手臂稍微弯曲。
暂停片刻，然后将杠铃举回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1380.description: A one-leg seated calf raise with a dumbbell held in a hammer grip. It trains the soleus under the calf one side at a time.
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell resting on your thighs.
Place one foot on a raised surface, such as a step or block, with your heel hanging off the edge.
Hold the dumbbell with a hammer grip, meaning your palms are facing each other and your fingers are wrapped around the handle.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, slowly raise your heel as high as possible by pushing through the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地面上，并将哑铃放在大腿上。
将一只脚放在凸起的表面上，例如台阶或木块，脚跟悬在边缘之外。
用锤式握法握住哑铃，这意味着您的手掌相对，手指缠绕在手柄上。
保持核心收紧，背部挺直，通过脚掌推动，将脚后跟慢慢抬高，尽可能高。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将脚跟放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换另一条腿。

1444.description: Holding a dumbbell over your chest with bent arms in a pullover position. It keeps the chest and lats under tension.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell with both hands over your chest.
Lower it behind your head with your elbows bent.
Stop where you feel a stretch in your chest and lats.
Hold the position with your core tight.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lift it back up.

1508.description: A band lateral raise that builds the sides of the shoulders.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Pause briefly without shrugging.
Lower slowly back to your sides.

1572.description: A seated machine squat using one leg in a wide stance. It loads the quads, glutes and inner thighs with back support.
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Place one foot wide on the platform and keep the other leg off the load.
Lower by bending your working knee as far as is comfortable.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Press back up, then switch legs after your reps.

1636.description: A curl with the cable set high so the arms are lifted overhead. It trains the biceps through a short range.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley cable machine.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary.
Exhale and curl the bar down towards your forehead, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly return the bar to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将直杆连接到高滑轮电缆机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
反手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
呼气并将杠铃向下卷向前额，保持上臂静止。
在动作底部暂停片刻，挤压二头肌。
吸气，慢慢地将杠铃返回到起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1700.description: An overhead dumbbell press that uses a small leg dip and drive for momentum. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level.
Bend your knees slightly and dip your body down, then explosively extend your legs and press the dumbbells overhead.
Lock out your arms at the top of the movement, then lower the dumbbells back to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，与肩同高。
稍微弯曲膝盖，身体下沉，然后爆发性伸展双腿，将哑铃压过头顶。
在动作的最高点锁定手臂，然后将哑铃放回肩部水平。
重复所需的重复次数。

1764.description: A hanging raise where you lift your legs and curl your hips up. Strengthens the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your legs up by flexing your hips and knees until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
弯曲臀部和膝盖，收紧核心并抬起双腿，直到大腿与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1828.description: Reaching your hand down your upper back stretches the triceps and the back of the shoulder. A common warm-up and cooldown stretch.
instructions: Raise one arm overhead, bend the elbow and drop your hand behind your head.
Use your other hand to press your elbow gently back and down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1892.description: Kneeling stretch with the heel pressed down to lengthen the Achilles.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Lean forward, keeping your front heel on the floor.
Press your front knee over your toes.
Feel the stretch behind the ankle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1956.description: Sitting back on your heels and leaning back to stretch both quadriceps at once.
instructions: Kneel and sit back so your hips rest on your heels.
Place your hands on the floor behind you.
Lean back slowly and lift the hips slightly until you feel a stretch in the front of both thighs.
Stop if you feel any pinch in the knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then come back up slowly.

2148.description: A one sided machine hip thrust that hits each glute on its own and challenges hip stability.
instructions: Sit on the machine with your upper back on the pad and the belt across your hips.
Plant one foot flat and lift the other leg off the floor.
Drive through the planted heel and raise your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glute at the top, keeping your hips level.
Lower with control, finish your reps, then switch legs.

2276.description: A machine crunch performed lying back, letting you load the abs while the lower back stays supported.
instructions: Lie back on the machine and place your hands or arms as indicated.
Hook your feet or grip the handles for stability.
Curl your torso up by contracting your abs.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Repeat for the planned reps.

2340.description: A side-by-side form check for shoulder position during the bench press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Lie on the bench and pinch your shoulder blades together before unracking.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your shoulder blades stay pulled back and down against the bench.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

2404.description: An EZ bar curl with an arm blaster. Isolates the biceps with a comfortable wrist angle.
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Place your upper arms against the arm blaster, keeping them stationary throughout the exercise.
Keeping your elbows close to your body, exhale and curl the barbell up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，反手握住 ez 杠铃，手掌朝上。
将上臂靠在手臂冲击波上，在整个练习过程中保持静止。
保持肘部靠近身体，呼气并将杠铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

2468.description: A side-on step up with dumbbells that builds the legs and glutes.
instructions: Stand beside a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Place your near foot on the bench.
Drive through that heel to step up onto the bench.
Bring your other foot up to balance.
Step down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

2660.description: A plate-loaded preacher machine curl that isolates the biceps with your upper arms supported.
instructions: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest flat on the pad.
Grip the handles with palms up.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.
Do not lift your elbows off the pad or let the weight drop.

2724.description: Lifting heavy round stones onto a platform, a classic test of full-body strength.
instructions: Straddle the stone and squat down to wrap your arms around it.
Lift it to your lap by driving the hips forward.
Roll the stone up your chest.
Extend your hips to load it on the platform.
Lower it back to the floor under control and reset.

2788.description: Twisting the trunk to each side, working the obliques and mobilising the spine.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and your arms crossed over your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side while keeping the hips facing forward.
Return to center, then rotate to the other side.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2852.description: A side-lying leg lift that works the outer hip.
instructions: Lie on your side with legs stacked.
Support your head with your arm.
Lift your top leg.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

2916.description: Walking while hugging a kettlebell at chest height. It trains posture, the trunk and the upper back.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns close to your chest, elbows tucked.
Stand tall with your ribs down and abs braced.
Walk with steady steps without leaning back.
Cover the set distance, keeping the bell high and still.
Set the kettlebell down with a flat back.

2980.description: A row from a plank position with dumbbells. It builds the back while your core fights rotation.
instructions: Start in a high plank with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet wide.
Brace your core.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it with control.
Repeat on the other side.

3108.description: A jumping jack with a squat landing. The extra depth makes it harder on the legs and your heart.
instructions: Stand with your feet together.
Jump your feet wide and land in a quarter squat.
Swing your arms out as you land.
Jump your feet back together.
Land softly each time.
Keep a quick, controlled pace.

3236.description: A kneeling hip thrust against a resistance band around the thighs. It trains the glutes with a hip extension.
instructions: Start by kneeling on the ground with your knees hip-width apart and your feet flexed.
Wrap the resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Place your hands on your hips or extend them out in front of you for balance.
Engage your glutes and core muscles.
Push your hips forward and squeeze your glutes as you lift your knees off the ground, extending your hips until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Hold the position for a moment, then slowly lower your knees back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先跪在地上，膝盖分开与臀部同宽，双脚弯曲。
将阻力带缠绕在大腿上，就在膝盖上方。
将双手放在臀部或向前伸展以保持平衡。
调动你的臀肌和核心肌肉。
当你将膝盖抬离地面时，向前推动臀部并挤压臀部，伸展臀部直到大腿与地面平行。
保持该姿势片刻，然后慢慢将膝盖放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3300.description: A leaning plank where the shoulders move forward past the hands. It trains the shoulders, wrists and core on the way to the planche.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your body straight.
Engage your core and slowly shift your weight forward, bringing your shoulders past your hands.
Keep your elbows slightly bent and your body straight as you lean forward.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开与肩同宽，身体伸直。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的重心向前移动，让你的肩膀越过你的手。
向前倾时，保持肘部稍微弯曲，身体伸直。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3364.description: A seated close grip cable press for the triceps with a stable base.
instructions: Sit on a bench facing away from a cable at chest height.
Hold the handle with a narrow grip.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Keep your back against the pad.
Return slowly and repeat.

3428.description: Lift dumbbells in front of you to work the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Brace your core and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise the weights in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without swinging your body.

3492.description: A kneeling push-up that ends with a rotation and one arm reaching up. It trains the chest and trunk control.
instructions: Start in a kneeling push-up position, hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press up and rotate your torso, lifting one arm toward the ceiling.
Look at your raised hand for a moment.
Bring the hand back down and lower for the next rep.
Alternate sides each rep.

3556.description: A running-in-place move with high knees. It raises the heart rate.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Run in place, driving your knees up toward waist height.
Pump your arms in rhythm.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your chest tall.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

3684.description: A light external rotation for the rotator cuff.
instructions: Lie on your side with a dumbbell in the top hand and elbow bent.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Rotate your forearm upward.
Lower slowly.
Switch sides after the set.

3748.description: A bicep curl using a bed sheet and your own opposing arm for resistance.
instructions: Hold a bed sheet with both hands, one arm pulling down, the other curling up.
Keep your elbow at your side.
Curl the working hand toward your shoulder against the resistance.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

3812.description: A push-up with your hands on a raised surface. It is easier than a floor push-up and a good way to build chest strength.
instructions: Place your hands on a bench or box slightly wider than your shoulders.
Step back so your body forms a straight line.
Lower your chest to the edge with your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips from sagging.

3876.description: A jump squat holding a plate at your chest, building leg power.
instructions: Hold a weight plate close to your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are near parallel.
Jump up explosively, extending your hips, knees and ankles.
Land softly and go straight into the next rep.
Keep your chest up throughout.

4004.description: Jogging on the spot as a warm-up or light cardio. It raises your heart rate without equipment.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms bent.
Jog in place, lifting your knees.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady pace.
Continue for 1-5 minutes.

4068.description: Bench press with three boards on the chest limiting the range. It overloads the lockout phase.
instructions: Lie on a bench with three boards stacked on your chest.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower the bar until it touches the boards.
Press back up to full extension.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched.

4132.description: A sumo deadlift flowing into a high pull, working legs, hips and upper back.
instructions: Stand wide over a kettlebell and grip it with both hands.
Drive up through your legs.
Pull it to chin height with elbows high.
Lower it under control.
Keep your back flat.

4196.description: A pallof press with the inner thigh engaged.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the cable at chest height.
Hold the handle at your chest.
Press it forward.
Squeeze your inner thigh.
Return.
Switch sides.

4388.description: A bodyweight get-up with your hands behind your head. It builds leg strength, balance and hip control.
instructions: Kneel on the floor, with your hands behind your head.
Keep your chest tall and your core braced.
Step one foot forward and drive up through it to stand.
Lower back down with control to kneeling.
Alternate the leading leg on each rep.

4452.description: A bent-over row with a band and a wide grip. Targets the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Stand on the band with feet hip width apart and grab it with a wide overhand grip.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Pull your hands toward your lower ribs, elbows flaring out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your torso still throughout.

4516.description: A light band drill that warms up the shoulder joint and loosens the surrounding muscles before training.
instructions: Hold a light band with both hands in front of your thighs, hands wide.
Keep your arms straight and your core braced.
Lift the band overhead and continue back behind your head as far as is comfortable.
Return along the same path to the start.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Repeat for 10-15 reps, widening your grip if it feels tight.

4580.description: A gentle spinal flow between arching and rounding the back to loosen the spine.
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and drop your belly, lifting your chest and tailbone into cow.
Exhale and round your back toward the ceiling into cat.
Tuck your chin and pull your belly in.
Move slowly between the two positions.
Repeat for 10-12 breaths.

4772.description: A kneeling kickback with the working leg kept straight, a second variation. It targets the glutes and the back of the thigh.
instructions: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Extend one leg straight behind you with the toes on the floor.
Squeeze the glute and lift the straight leg to hip height.
Pause briefly, then lower the leg without letting the back arch.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

4836.description: A dumbbell press with a reverse grip and the weights squeezed together. It emphasises the triceps and inner chest.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding two dumbbells together over your chest with a reverse (palms toward you) grip.
Squeeze the dumbbells together firmly.
Lower them to your chest with elbows close to your body.
Press back up, keeping the squeeze.
Keep your wrists straight throughout.

4900.description: A seated calf raise with the balls of the feet on a raised surface for a deeper stretch. It targets the lower calf muscle.
instructions: Sit on a bench with the balls of your feet on a raised step.
Rest weight or your hands on your thighs.
Lower your heels as far as you comfortably can.
Press up onto your toes as high as possible.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

4964.description: An explosive jump with a shrug at the top. It builds hip power for the Olympic lifts.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell at hip height.
Dip slightly with your knees.
Jump explosively and extend fully.
Shrug your shoulders at the top.
Land softly with bent knees.
Keep the bar close to your body.

5028.description: Split squat holding one dumbbell at your chest. It builds the legs and glutes one side at a time.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell vertically at your chest and step into a long split stance.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Drive through your front heel to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

5092.description: Lift one dumbbell to the front with your palm facing up. This variation trains the front delt and upper chest.
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing forward.
Keep your core braced.
Raise the dumbbell in front of you to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly to your thigh.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.

5156.description: From a plank, slide your feet on towels to bring your knees to your chest. A core and cardio move that is easy on the joints.
instructions: Place your feet on towels on a smooth floor and get into a plank.
Keep your core tight and shoulders over your wrists.
Slide one knee toward your chest.
Slide it back and switch legs.
Keep a steady pace and a flat back.

5220.description: A wide-legged yoga lunge with a long side stretch. It opens the hips and sides of the body.
instructions: Step your feet wide apart and turn one foot out.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Rest your forearm on your thigh and reach the other arm overhead.
Lengthen the whole side body and look up if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.

5284.description: Pressing dumbbells from the chest while driving one knee up like a sprinter. It combines upper body strength with a core-driven leg movement.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells at your chest.
Drive one knee up toward your chest.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight.
Lower the dumbbells and switch legs.
Keep a steady rhythm.

5476.description: A hip thrust with one foot set slightly ahead of the other. Shifts more load to one side and challenges hip stability.
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a barbell over your hips.
Place one foot slightly ahead of the other.
Drive through your feet to lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, keeping your chin tucked.
Lower under control, and swap the foot position on the next set.

5668.description: A standing overhead press starting from a dead stop on safety pins. Without the stretch reflex, it builds pressing strength out of the bottom position.
instructions: Set the bar on safety pins at about shoulder height in a rack.
Step under it and grip just outside shoulder width.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar overhead, moving your head slightly back then through.
Lower the bar to rest on the pins, pause, and repeat.

5860.description: Hold a kettlebell behind your head and straighten your arms overhead. It isolates the triceps.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns with both hands overhead.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms until they are straight.
Repeat without flaring your elbows.

5988.description: A light deadlift holding a bottle in each hand. A good way to learn the hip hinge.
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand and stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at your hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Lower the bottles along your legs to mid-shin.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

6052.description: A crunch with a bottle held overhead. The extra lever length makes your abs work harder.
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle with both hands above your chest.
Extend your arms overhead or keep them over your face.
Curl your ribs toward your hips and lift your shoulders off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without dropping your head.

6692.description: The classic barbell deadlift shown from the side to check form. It trains the whole posterior chain.
instructions: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and grip it just outside your legs.
Brace your core, flatten your back and pull the slack out of the bar.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out the hips without leaning back.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bar under control.

6756.description: A light rotation drill with a cable that turns the arm inward. It builds rotator cuff strength and shoulder stability.
instructions: Kneel side-on to a low cable and hold the handle with the near hand.
Tuck your elbow at your side, bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm inward across your belly.
Pause briefly at the end.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.

6820.description: A fly on an incline bench using kettlebells. It stretches and works the upper chest.
instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding a kettlebell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a soft bend in the elbows.
Open your arms wide in an arc until you feel a chest stretch.
Squeeze the chest to bring the weights back together.
Control the weights and keep your wrists stable.

7204.description: A second take on the band glute kickback, balancing on one leg while the other presses back.
instructions: Place the band around your ankles and stand tall on one leg.
Hold a wall or rail for balance if needed.
Keep a slight bend in your standing knee.
Kick the other leg back, squeezing the glute.
Return slowly without leaning forward.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

7588.description: Hold a weight plate out in front of you at shoulder height. It builds endurance in the front delts.
instructions: Stand tall holding a weight plate with both hands at your thighs.
Raise it straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Keep your arms nearly straight and your ribs down.
Hold the position, breathing steadily, for 20-40 seconds.
Lower the plate slowly with control.

8612.description: A seated ankle drill that works the muscles on the inside of the lower leg.
instructions: Sit with one leg extended and loop the band around the forefoot, anchored on the outside.
Keep your leg still.
Turn your foot inward against the band.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch feet.

9316.description: A pike push up with feet elevated and hands on rings, so you go deeper. It builds strong overhead pressing.
instructions: Set the rings low and put your hands on them with your feet on a box.
Raise your hips into a pike shape.
Lower your head between the rings.
Keep the rings steady and close to your body.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.

9700.description: A walking lunge with a deep, low position that opens the hips and works the glutes and thighs.
instructions: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee close to the floor.
Push through your front foot and step the back leg forward.
Continue walking forward, alternating legs.

10660.description: A one-arm pull-up with a band under your foot or knee to reduce the load. It builds toward unassisted single-arm pulling.
instructions: Loop a band over the bar and place your foot or knee in it.
Hang with one hand on the bar and the other holding your wrist or the band.
Pull your chin toward the bar, driving the elbow down.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control to a full hang.
Switch arms after each set.

10852.description: A reformer split stance with the carriage sliding. It works the legs, glutes and balance.
instructions: Place one foot on the carriage and one on the platform.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Slide the carriage back while lowering into a split squat.
Pause.
Press back to the start.
Switch sides after your set.

10916.description: A single-leg hinge where you reach to touch your toes. It trains balance and the hamstrings.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward as the free leg lifts behind you.
Reach your hands toward the toes of the standing foot.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Stand back up with control. Finish your reps and switch legs.

0036.description: A wide-grip decline bench press that spreads the load across the lower chest.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and your head lower than your hips.
Grasp the barbell with a wide grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lower the barbell to your chest, keeping your elbows out to the sides.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，双脚固定，头部低于臀部。
宽握距抓住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃降低到胸部，保持肘部向两侧伸出。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

0100.description: A shoulder exercise in which you swing the barbell through a skiing-like pattern. Trains the delts and core.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Simultaneously lift the barbell up towards your shoulders while jumping slightly off the ground.
As you reach the top of the movement, quickly reverse the motion and lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃于大腿前方。
稍微弯曲膝盖，臀部向前转动，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
同时将杠铃举向肩膀，同时稍微离开地面。
当您到达动作的最高点时，快速反转动作并将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0164.description: A cable front raise for the shoulders.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and grasp the cable handle with an overhand grip.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Raise the cable handle in front of you, keeping your arms straight and your palms facing down.
Continue lifting until your arms are parallel to the floor.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the cable handle back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，并用正手握住电缆手柄。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将电缆手柄举到您面前，保持手臂伸直，手掌朝下。
继续抬起，直到手臂与地板平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将拉索手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0228.description: A standing cable hip extension with an ankle cuff. Kicking the leg back squeezes the glutes, one side at a time.
instructions: Attach a cable to a low pulley and stand facing away from the machine.
Place the cable around your ankle and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the exercise.
Slowly extend your leg straight back, squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Switch sides and repeat with the other leg.
instructionsZh: 将电缆连接到低滑轮上，并背对机器站立。
将电缆绕在脚踝上，双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
在整个练习过程中保持核心参与并保持背部挺直。
慢慢地将腿向后伸直，在动作的最高点挤压臀部。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
换边并用另一条腿重复。

0292.description: A one-arm dumbbell row from a hinged stance. It trains the upper back one side at a time.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing your body.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Let the dumbbell hang straight down towards the floor, with your arm fully extended.
Pull the dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一手握住哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
让哑铃垂直垂向地板，手臂完全伸展。
将哑铃向上拉向胸部，保持肘部靠近身体并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0356.description: A one-arm lateral raise with your free hand braced on a support. The support lets you focus on the side shoulder without swinging.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand, with your palm facing your body.
Place your other hand on a stable surface, such as a bench or wall, for support.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side, keeping your arm straight and your palm facing down.
Continue lifting until your arm is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一手握住哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
将另一只手放在稳定的表面（例如长凳或墙壁）上以获得支撑。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
将哑铃向一侧举起，保持手臂伸直，手掌朝下。
继续抬起，直到手臂与地面平行。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0420.description: Bent forward, you straighten your arms behind you with dumbbells. It isolates the triceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Extend your arms straight back, squeezing your triceps at the top of the movement.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将手臂向后伸直，在动作的最高点挤压三头肌。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0484.description: Lying on your back with bent knees, you raise your hips toward the ceiling. It works the lower abs and glutes.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands by your sides, palms facing down.
Engage your core and glutes, then lift your hips off the ground until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在身体两侧，掌心朝下。
收紧核心肌群和臀肌，然后将臀部抬离地面，直到身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0548.description: A wide stance pull where you drive through your legs and row a kettlebell up to chest height. Hits the traps, shoulders and hips.
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing outwards.
Hold a kettlebell with both hands in front of your body, arms extended downwards.
Bend your knees and lower your hips into a squat position, keeping your back straight.
Drive through your heels and explosively extend your hips and knees, pulling the kettlebell up towards your chin.
As you pull the kettlebell up, keep your elbows high and wide, and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower the kettlebell back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开比肩宽，脚趾朝外。
双手握住壶铃放在身体前方，手臂向下伸展。
弯曲膝盖，降低臀部至下蹲位置，保持背部挺直。
脚后跟发力，爆发性伸展臀部和膝盖，将壶铃拉向下巴。
当你向上拉壶铃时，保持肘部高且宽，并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将壶铃放回起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。

0612.description: A classic step forward and drop for the legs. It builds the quads and glutes and improves balance.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Take a big step forward with one leg.
Lower your hips until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Repeat and switch legs.

0676.description: A reverse lunge that ends with a forward kick. It trains the glutes and legs, and tests balance.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg back into a lunge.
Push through the front heel to stand.
Kick the rear leg forward.
Place the foot down behind you for the next rep.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

0740.description: On a 45 degree sled, you press with a wide stance. Works the inner thighs, glutes and quads.
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the sled machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the foot platform.
Position your feet wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push against the foot platform to extend your legs and straighten your knees.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly bend your knees to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将雪橇机调整至 45 度角。
坐在雪橇机上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚放在脚踏平台上。
双脚分开的距离比肩宽。
推动脚部平台以伸展双腿并伸直膝盖。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢弯曲膝盖回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0868.description: A standing curl using a cable and an underhand grip. It keeps constant tension on the biceps.
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the cable attachment with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary.
Exhale and curl the cable attachment towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the cable attachment back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
用手握住电缆附件，手掌朝上。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
呼气并将电缆附件卷向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并缓慢地将电缆附件放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0996.description: A seated hip rotation against a band around the thighs. It works the glutes and hip muscles.
instructions: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Place a resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Keep your knees bent at a 90-degree angle and your feet shoulder-width apart.
Engage your glutes and slowly rotate your knees outward, pushing against the resistance of the band.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
在大腿周围、膝盖上方放置一条阻力带。
保持膝盖弯曲 90 度，双脚分开与肩同宽。
收紧臀肌，慢慢向外旋转膝盖，克服弹力带的阻力。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
